b: In this episode, Leila Latif and Hannah Strong celebrate the release of Eleanor Coppola's Making Marie Antoinette, out in UK cinemas from 23 Oct and streaming on MUBI from 6 November, and to also look deeper into the "Making of…" movie and films about filmmaking. The pair also go deep on Theo Rollason's Queer Edward II which will hopefully be released into UK cinemas in 2027.
